name: Minecraft Bedrock Edition
tagline: A Minecraft server for players on consoles, phones and tablets.
description: Runs a Minecraft Bedrock Edition server, the edition played on consoles, phones and tablets, using the itzg image. The official server is downloaded and kept up to date at start.
postInstall: The first start downloads the server and builds the world: follow it in Logs.
In Minecraft, open Play, Servers, Add Server, and enter this server's address with the game port (19132 by default).
To play from outside your home, forward the game port (UDP) on your router.

env.prompt: Type TRUE to accept the Minecraft EULA (minecraft.net/eula)
